'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 May Day protests]]
**[[2025–2026 Turkish protests]]
***[[General Directorate of Security (Turkey)|Turkish police]] arrest at least 57 people and use [[tear gas]] to disperse [[International Workers' Day|May Day]] demonstrators in [[Istanbul]], where authorities block access to [[Taksim Square]] to prevent marches. [https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2026/05/01/turkish-cops-fire-tear-gas-arrest-dozens-at-may-day-rallies (AFP via ''FMT'')]
**Protests and demonstrations are held worldwide on [[International Workers' Day|May Day]] to call for peace, higher wages and better working conditions. Additionally, protests are held [[Protests against the 2026 Iran war|against the Iran war]] and the [[2026 Iran war fuel crisis|global energy and fuel crisis]] caused by the war. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/economy/what-to-know-about-may-day-as-workers-face-rising-costs-due-to-iran-war (PBS)] [https://www.commondreams.org/news/may-day-protests-2026 (Common Dreams)]
**A [[Labour Day]] rally organized by [[Kilusang Mayo Uno]] is held in [[Manila]], [[Philippines]]. During the rally, protesters attempt to storm the [[Embassy of the United States, Manila|U.S. embassy]] to [[Protests against the 2026 Iran war|demand]] an end to the Iran war and clash with police, injuring seven officers. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2221850/police-protesters-clash-over-cops-hurt-at-labor-day-rally-effigy-burningq (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')] [https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20260501/f5c1c4a19a2f42a39085ec7cc1dc09a5/c.html (Xinhua)]
**May Day protests are held across the [[United States|U.S.]], including an economic blackout as part of 3,500 "May Day Strong" events across the country. Additionally, demonstrations are held outside institutions such as the [[New York Stock Exchange]]. [https://time.com/article/2026/05/01/may-day-international-workers-day-protests-rallies-marches-us/ (''Time'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/may/01/may-day-strong-economic-protests (''The Guardian'')]

*[[Killing of Kumanjayi Little Baby]]
**Members of [[Alice Springs]]' [[Aboriginal Australians|Aboriginal]] community in [[Northern Territory]], [[Australia]], clash with [[Northern Territory Police Force|police]] outside a hospital where a man charged with the [[Murder in Australian law|murder]] of a five-year-old [[Warlpiri people|Warlpiri]] girl is being treated, demanding the suspect be punished under traditional law. This follows a five-day search for the missing girl with large community participation before she was confirmed dead. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/apr/30/jefferson-lewis-arrested-over-death-of-kumanjayi-little-baby-in-northern-territory (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Rubén Rocha Moya]] announces he will temporarily step down as [[Governor of Sinaloa|governor]] of [[Sinaloa]], Mexico, after the U.S. files charges alleging links to the [[Sinaloa Cartel]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexican-governor-ruben-rocha-steps-down-nyt-reports-2026-05-02/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Renters' Rights Act 2025]] formally enters force in [[England]], banning [[Section 21 notice]]s (no-fault [[eviction]]s), limiting [[renting|rent]] increases to once per year, giving tenants the legal right to keep pets, abolishing [[assured shorthold tenancy|assured shorthold tenancies]], and making it illegal to discriminate against tenants based on them having children, or receiving [[Welfare state in the United Kingdom|benefits]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/renters-rights-act-2026-no-fault-evictions-b2968188.html (''The Independent'')]
*One person is killed and 11 others are injured in a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] in [[Chengdu]], [[Sichuan]], [[China]]. The suspect is arrested. [https://www.thestandard.com.hk/china/article/330903/One-dead-11-injured-in-horrific-hit-and-run-rampage-in-Chengdu (''The Standard'')]
*[[Spain]]'s [[Civil Guard (Spain)|Civil Guard]] seizes between 30,000 to 45,000kg of [[cocaine]] on a [[cargo ship]] off the [[Canary Islands]] in what is the country's largest ever seizure of the [[illegal drug trade|illegal drug]]. Twenty people on board the vessel are arrested. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8pn8py5gro (BBC News)]
